changes.reason: The default isolated RSC encoder accepts and forwards exactly platform-only Node metadata; both sides validate the narrow context contract and continue refusing additional host values.

kubernetes.reason: The Node fetch adapters and default isolated encoder render the real server component as HTML and negotiated Flight in the local Node host harness.
constraints: Node child_process and the installed encoder entry with React server dependencies are required.
Only platform-only Node metadata crosses the pipe; live host context is rejected.
Local host-runtime evidence does not certify a deployed Kubernetes cluster.

evidence.testName: Node RSC context through the standalone adapter renders the real component as HTML and negotiated Flight with Node metadata

aws-lambda.reason: This fix covers the Node adapters only. The Lambda adapter supplies event and invocation context that the default isolated encoder still rejects.
constraints: No Lambda RSC integration or deployment evidence is claimed.
The existing buffered Lambda response contract is unchanged.

cloudflare.reason: The default isolated encoder needs Node child_process and cannot carry Workers bindings or executionContext.
constraints: No Workers isolate or Node Container support is added by this change.
